apiCallers.packages/github/: The module itself: every request the deployment sends GitHub's API leaves through it.
apiCallers.apps/web/server/preview-deployment.ts: CI's preview probe, run by a workflow on the workflow's own token and never by the deployment, so it shares no identity, quota, or hold with the module.
apiCallers.packages/service/src/agents/sandbox-fire: Names GitHub's hosts for the sandbox firewall to set an agent's credential on its own git and gh requests; it sends GitHub nothing itself.

tokenOpeners.packages/service/src/github/github-token: The `GitHubMemberTokens` implementation (`memberTokensOver`): the one place a member's saved token is opened, for `@repo/github` to use.
tokenOpeners.packages/service/src/github/github-app.t: Hands `memberTokensOver` to `@repo/github`'s member-token operations, and opens no token itself.
